verdict.rationale: Render documents official SDKs for TypeScript and Python, but the evidence scopes them to Workflows: defining workflow tasks and triggering their runs. It does not show general-purpose SDKs for managing services, datastores or deploys. The REST API and OpenAPI spec are building blocks, not official SDKs. missing for 10: general platform-management SDK coverage beyond workflows, SDKs in more languages, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Render SDK for TypeScript provides support for: - Defining workflow tasks - Triggering runs of those tasks from your other TypeScript code
The Render SDK for Python provides support for: - Defining workflow tasks - Triggering runs of those tasks from your other Python code
